List of highest-grossing Hindi films

Hindi cinema, popularly known as Bollywood, consisting of films in the Hindi language. This ranking lists the highest-grossing Hindi films, originally made in Hindi language, based on conservative global box office estimates as reported by organizations classified as green by Wikipedia. The figures are not adjusted for inflation. However, there is no official tracking of figures, and sources publishing data are frequently pressured to increase their estimates.

Background shading indicates that a film, or at least one from a series, is currently showing in theatres worldwide.

Several factors have contributed to this expansion, including wider international releases, diverse content, and effective marketing. results.title: 1000 Crore Club
results.text:
1000 Crore Club

1000 Crore Club is an unofficial designation by the Indian film trade and media, related to Indian language films that have grossed₹ 1000 crore(10 billion Indian rupees or $135 million) or more either domestically within India or worldwide. It is preceded by the 100 Crore Club. In 2017, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion became the first Indian film to gross over ₹1,000 crore worldwide. It grossed ₹1,430 crore (equivalent to ₹20 billion or US$210 million in 2023) across all languages in India and grossed ₹1,810 crore (equivalent to ₹25 billion or US$260 million in 2023) worldwide. It stands as the highest-grossing film in India till date.

Baahubali 2 was followed by Dangal, which is the highest-grossing Indian film globally till date, which grossed over ₹2,000 crore (US$307.12 million). In 2022, two films released in the span of a month, RRR and KGF: Chapter 2, grossed over ₹1,000 crore at the global box office. The club expanded with films like Pathaan(2023), Jawan(2023), Kalki 2898 AD(2024), and Pushpa 2: The Rule(2024), with the latter being the fastest to achieve the record (in 6 days). The Dhurandhar has been the only franchise of which two films crossed ₹1000 crore; Dhurandhar(2025) and Dhurandhar: The Revenge(2026).

## History

Baahubali 2: The Conclusion, released on 28 April 2017, became the first Indian film to cross the ₹1,000 crore (US$153.56 million) mark in May 2017, and briefly became the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide, before being overtaken by Dangal with the help of Chinese release.

Baahubali 2 is the highest-grossing film in India till date, where it has grossed ₹1,429 crore (US$219.44 million). The film became the highest grossing film in 28 out of the 29 Indian states at the time of its release, a feat achieved by no other film since. Overseas, it was the highest-grossing Indian film of its time in the United States($21 million), where it became the first Indian film to cross $20 million, as well as becoming the first Indian film to gross over $10 million in the United Arab Emirates.

Dangal(2016), following its Chinese release on 5 May 2017, became the highest-grossing Indian film of all time and fifth highest-grossing non- English language film of that time, crossing ₹2,000 crore ($307.12 million) worldwide, making it the first Indian film to gross $300 million worldwide and one of the top 30 highest-grossing 2016 films(surpassing the $299.5 million gross of Alice Through the Looking Glass). Dangal is also the highest-grossing sports film of 2017, and Disney's fourth highest-grossing film of 2017. Dangal is the first Indian film to exceed $200 million overseas, crossing over ₹1,400 crore ($215 million) in international markets, including¥ 1.29 billion (US$191 million) in China and ₹41 crore ($6.3 million) in Taiwan. Its overseas gross in China more than doubled its domestic gross of $84.4 million in India.

Dhurandhar: The Revenge(2026) became the first Indian film to cross ₹1,000 crore net in a single language (Hindi); netting over ₹1,100 crore in all languages; in addition, it became the highest-grossing Indian film in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia and Canada.

S. S. Rajamouli, the director of Baahubali 2: The Conclusion(2017) and RRR(2022) and Aditya Dhar, the director of Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge are the only two Indian film directors to direct two films that earned over ₹1000 crore. Prabhas, Shah Rukh Khan and Ranveer Singh are the only lead actors with two films in the ₹1000 crore club.

## List

This is a list of the films in the 1000 crore club, without adjusted for inflation. For the list of the highest-grossing Indian films in terms of nominal value (without adjusted for inflation), see list of highest-grossing Indian films.

results.text:
List of highest-grossing Indian films

This ranking lists the highest-grossing Indian films produced by Indian cinema, based on conservative global box office estimates as reported by organisations classified as green by Wikipedia. The figures are not adjusted for inflation. However, there is no official tracking of figures and sources publishing data are frequently pressured to increase their estimates.

## Overview

Indian films have been screened in markets around the world since the early 20th century. Since 2003, there are markets in over 90 countries where films from India are screened. During the first decade of the 21st century, there was a steady rise in the ticket price, a tripling in the number of theatres and an increase in the number of prints of a film being released, which led to a large increase in the box office collections.

As of 2014, Hindi cinema represents 43% of the net box office revenue in India, while Telugu and Tamil cinema represent 36%, and other industries constitute 21%. As of 2020, the combined revenue of all other language film industries has surpassed that of the Hindi film industry. By 2021, Telugu cinema became the largest film industry of India in terms of box-office. In 2023, the Hindi film industry accounted for 44% of box office revenue, followed by the Telugu industry at 19% and the Tamil industry at 16%. The Kannada(5%), Malayalam(3%), Bengali, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Gujarati and Bhojpuri industries contributed to the remainder, while the foreign film industry made up 9% of the total revenue. In 2024, the Hindi and the Telugu film industries accounted for 40% and 20% of the domestic gross box office revenue respectively, followed by Tamil with 15% share and Malayalam with 10% share.

### Worldwide Box Office

In an era where cinema knows no boundaries, Bollywood has evolved into a global force, captivating audiences from Mumbai to Melbourne, Toronto to Tokyo. As Indian films continue to scale...&nbspnew creative and commercial heights, tracking the Bollywood worldwide box office collection has become more than just a numbers game—it’s a reflection of the industry's expanding footprint across continents. This page is your definitive destination for understanding how Hindi films are performing on a global scale, offering insights into the highest-grossing titles that have not only resonated with domestic audiences but have also made a thunderous impact in international markets. For decades, Bollywood was seen primarily as a domestic juggernaut, with its box office potential largely measured within India’s borders. However, with the rise of a massive Indian diaspora, a more interconnected world, and the increasing curiosity of international audiences, Hindi films have found firm ground overseas. This shift has turned the spotlight on Bollywood overseas box office reports, which now serve as crucial indicators of a film’s total commercial success. Today, a major Bollywood release doesn’t just open big in India—it simultaneously releases in North America, the UK, UAE, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, and sometimes even China, raking in millions globally within days. This growing international appeal has led to the emergence of a new kind of Bollywood blockbuster—one that is defined not just by its opening weekend at home, but by its total global reach. Films like Dangal, Pathaan, PK, Jawan, and Bajrangi Bhaijaan have each rewritten the rules, pushing past the ₹500 crore, ₹600 crore, and even ₹800 crore worldwide benchmarks. These are not isolated successes but indicators of a trend where emotionally resonant storytelling, powerful performances, and high production values are attracting viewers across language and cultural barriers. Such titles proudly sit atop the list of the top grossing Bollywood movies worldwide, proving that Indian cinema has become a key player in the global box office conversation. This page offers more than just a tally of figures—it captures the narrative of Bollywood’s global journey. Every film listed here has contributed to expanding the industry's global presence, whether through massive theatrical runs in the Middle East, surprisingly strong box office legs in East Asia, or record-setting premieres in North America and Europe. The Bollywood worldwide box office collection charted here is comprehensive and regularly updated, offering a transparent, in-depth look at how Hindi films perform both at home and abroad. It serves as a valuable tool for film professionals, marketers, analysts, journalists, and fans who want to understand which films are truly leading the charge on the world stage. Moreover, the significance of international box office numbers goes far beyond bragging rights. For producers and distributors, the Bollywood overseas box office report is crucial for planning international release strategies, identifying high-potential markets, and maximizing return on investment. For trade analysts and entertainment media, it helps decode audience trends and the global appetite for Indian content. And for film lovers, it’s a way to celebrate Indian cinema’s ascent as a cultural ambassador across borders. The data curated on this page not only ranks these global hits but also tells a story—of shifting tastes, rising star power, and the ever-growing cultural currency of Bollywood films. From the inspiring rise of Dangal in China to the phenomenal run of Jawan in Gulf territories and Europe, each milestone listed here marks a moment when Indian storytelling struck a universal chord. Whether it’s drama, romance, action, or satire, these films showcase the emotional depth and versatility that have made Bollywood a fixture in the global entertainment space. In summary, this page is more than a statistical archive; it is a living, breathing record of Bollywood’s global success. It celebrates not just the numbers but the narratives behind them. Whether you're a die-hard fan, a trade expert, or someone simply curious about the reach of Indian cinema, the information here offers a thorough view of the Bollywood worldwide box office collection, the top grossing Bollywood movies worldwide, and an updated, insightful Bollywood overseas box office report. Dive in, explore the data, and witness how Bollywood continues to captivate the world—one box office milestone at a time. Read more

## Indian films beyond Bollywood

Many believe that Bollywood is synonymous with the Indian film industry, but there is far more to it than that. Bollywood is the Hindi language film industry based in Mumbai and is just one component of the larger Indian film industry, which is made up of various production centers in various languages.

Nowadays, South Indian films have a growing fan base not just among native speakers but also Hindi audiences and the Indian diaspora worldwide. Tamil and Telugu cinema, respectively known as Kollywood and Tollywood, are among the major contributors of Indian cinema in terms of both revenue and releases.

## Asia's leading film markets

When it comes to Asian cinema, Bollywood isn’t the only multi-million dollar film industry. Chinese films are also proving to be popular with audiences, considering the box office revenue of the most successful movies of all time in China. As of May 2018, the most successful movie ever in China was Chinese director Wu Jing's action film ‘Wolf Warriors 2’, and in second place was 'Operation Red Sea' which generated ******* million Yuan at the Chinese box office.

Top 10 Highest Grossing Bollywood Movies Worldwide: Dangal To Pathaan (With Collections) - ZEE5 Blog

# Top 10 Highest Grossing Bollywood Movies Worldwide: Dangal To Pathaan (With Collections)

Every few years, Bollywood (and Bollywood-adjacent Hindi releases) delivers a set of films that don’t just “do well”—they rewrite the ceiling. You can feel it in the trade chatter: the Monday-morning collection updates get shared like cricket scores, theatre owners start using words like “phenomenon,” and suddenly everyone has an opinion on footfalls, overseas markets, and whether the film has “legs.”

Page Contents:

Toggle

Pulled from Sacnilk’s data, these are the Top 10 Highest Grossing Bollywood Movies Worldwide —and the box office numbers that put them in rare air.

## Dangal — ₹2,070.30 Cr Worldwide

Dangal shows what comes when a film grows past fun and turns into a movement that moves across lands. India brings a big gross, but the real news comes from foreign sales that push the film to the stars: ₹1,535.30 Cr foreign, lifting it to ₹2,070.30 Cr WW. In box office talk, this film pulls families, repeat fans, and people who skip halls, because the story speaks to hearts and invites many who avoid cinemas for shared joy.

## Related Posts:

- September 2025 Highlights: Must-Watch Movies,…
- Top 10 Highest Paid Actresses in India 2025: Alia vs…
- The Bengal Files box office collection: Day 11…
- ZEE5 Annual vs Monthly OTT Subscriptions: Which Is…
- Before You Stream Saali Mohabbat Or Heartiley…

## Dhurandhar — ₹1,296.30 Cr Worldwide

There are big openers… and then there are films that look like they’re playing a different sport. With ₹1,001.30 Cr India gross and ₹1,296.30 Cr worldwide, Dhurandhar sits at No. 2 on this list with sheer scale. When a film crosses this kind of number, it’s usually a combination of spectacle + repeat value + that intangible “event” factor that makes people choose theatres over sofas.

## Jawan — ₹1,160.00 Cr Worldwide

Jawan didn’t just perform—it dominated. Sacnilk lists ₹760.00 Cr India gross and ₹400.00 Cr overseas, totalling ₹1,160.00 Cr WW. I’ve always believed the biggest blockbusters have one secret ingredient: they feel like a community watch. Jawan had that. People didn’t go alone—they went in packs.

## Pathaan — ₹1,055.00 Cr Worldwide

Box office runs show what crowds skip and what brings them back. Pathaan earns ₹657.50 Cr in India, ₹397.50 Cr outside India, and ₹1,055.00 Cr across the world. The film shows overseas sales as a force when a movie turns into a global pop culture event for fans around towns.

## Bajrangi Bhaijaan — ₹921.93 Cr Worldwide

Some films make money; a few make people softer. Bajrangi Bhaijaan stands as a rare blockbuster people remember for heart and numbers from fans across lands: ₹432.46 Cr India gross, ₹489.47 Cr overseas, ₹921.93 Cr WW. The overseas share gives a clear sign—this story crossed borders in plot and in impact for hearts across wide nations.

## Animal — ₹915.00 Cr Worldwide

Animal is proof that polarising cinema can still be unstoppable cinema. With ₹660.00 Cr India gross and ₹915.00 Cr worldwide, it’s one of the defining box office statements of its era. Whether people came for the intensity, the soundtrack, the star pull, or the sheer curiosity—once the conversation gets loud enough, the box office usually follows.

## Secret Superstar — ₹912.75 Cr Worldwide

If this list has a plot twist entry, it’s Secret Superstar. Look at the split: ₹81.28 Cr India gross versus a staggering ₹831.47 Cr overseas, totalling ₹912.75 Cr WW. That’s not just success—it’s a case study in how a film can find its true superpower outside the home market and turn into an international juggernaut.

## Stree 2 — ₹857.15 Cr Worldwide

Horror-comedy is often dismissed as “light,” until it starts printing heavyweight numbers. Stree 2 earns ₹713.15 Cr India and reaches ₹857.15 Cr worldwide. This run shows the genre is big it feels mainstream and it can lift big weekends like action films in past years for many fans global audiences.

## Chhaava — ₹807.91 Cr Worldwide

With ₹716.91 Cr India gross and ₹807.91 Cr worldwide, Chhaava is a reminder that strong local resonance can create massive national pull. Films rooted in identity, history, and pride often behave differently at the box office: they don’t just attract viewers—they attract believers.

## PK — ₹792.00 Cr Worldwide

PK remains one of the most fascinating “big” hits because it’s a blockbuster driven by ideas as much as entertainment. Sacnilk lists ₹489.00 Cr India gross, ₹303.00 Cr overseas, and ₹792.00 Cr worldwide. It’s the kind of film where the debate outside the theatre becomes free marketing—and the curiosity factor keeps tickets moving.

## What This Top 10 Really Says About Box Office Power

Stare at these numbers long enough and you’ll notice a pattern: there isn’t one single formula. Some titles explode in India, some travel internationally like wildfire, and some do both with ease. The “worldwide highest-grossing” label is the entry gate—this list is what happens when films go far beyond the gate and start building monuments.

List of highest-grossing Indian films

This ranking lists the highest-grossing Indian films produced by Indian cinema, based on conservative global box office estimates as reported by organisations classified as green by Wikipedia. The figures are not adjusted for inflation. However, there is no official tracking of figures and sources publishing data are frequently pressured to increase their estimates.

## Overview

Indian films have been screened in markets around the world since the early 20th century. Since 2003, there are markets in over 90 countries where films from India are screened. During the first decade of the 21st century, there was a steady rise in the ticket price, a tripling in the number of theatres and an increase in the number of prints of a film being released, which led to a large increase in the box office collections.

As of 2014, Hindi cinema represents 43% of the net box office revenue in India, while Telugu and Tamil cinema represent 36%, and other industries constitute 21%. As of 2020, the combined revenue of all other language film industries has surpassed that of the Hindi film industry. By 2021, Telugu cinema became the largest film industry of India in terms of box-office. In 2023, the Hindi film industry accounted for 44% of box office revenue, followed by the Telugu industry at 19% and the Tamil industry at 16%. The Kannada(5%), Malayalam(3%), Bengali, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Gujarati and Bhojpuri industries contributed to the remainder, while the foreign film industry made up 9% of the total revenue. In 2024, the Hindi and the Telugu film industries accounted for 40% and 20% of the domestic gross box office revenue respectively, followed by Tamil with 15% share and Malayalam with 10% share.

# Dhurandhar 2 Final Worldwide Box Office Collection: Ranveer Singh’s Blockbuster Run Ends After 12 Glorious Weeks

### Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar 2 concludes a historic 12-week theatrical run with record-breaking collections worldwide. Check out Dhurandhar The Revenge final box office collection.

Praneet Samaiya June 11, 2026

845Views

https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F&via=x.compraneetsamaiya https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F&media=https://www.cine-tales.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Dhurandhar-2-Day-3-Box-Office-Collection.jpg&description=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks https://linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F&title=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks https://www.tumblr.com/share/link?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F&name=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks&description=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks https://www.reddit.com/submit?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cine-tales.com%2Fdhurandhar-2-final-worldwide-collection-ranveer%2F&title=Dhurandhar+2+Final+Worldwide+Box+Office+Collection%3A+Ranveer+Singh%E2%80%99s+Blockbuster+Run+Ends+After+12+Glorious+Weeks

Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar have delivered a phenomenon with Dhurandhar: The Revenge. What started as one of the most anticipated releases of 2026 eventually turned into a box office storm that rewrote multiple records across domestic and international markets. Over the course of nearly three months, the spy-action entertainer dominated cinemas, shattered milestones, and established itself among the biggest successes in Indian cinema history.

The journey of Dhurandhar 2 was special from the very first day. The film opened to extraordinary numbers, maintained a remarkable hold during weekdays, and continued attracting audiences for weeks. Even as new releases entered the market, the sequel kept finding viewers, proving that strong content and audience approval remain the biggest driving forces at the box office.

Now, after an incredible theatrical journey spanning around 85 days, the film has finally concluded its run. The final numbers are nothing short of historic.

## Dhurandhar 2 Final Worldwide Collection

| Market | Collection |
| --- | --- |
| India Net | ₹1186.32 crore |
| India Gross | ₹1399.85 crore |
| Overseas Gross | ₹451 crore |
| Worldwide Gross | ₹1850.85 crore |

According to the final update, Dhurandhar: The Revenge has concluded its theatrical run with a staggering ₹1850.85 crore gross worldwide. The film accumulated ₹1186.32 crore net in India, making it the highest-grossing Bollywood film ever at the domestic box office. Including taxes, the India gross collection stands at ₹1399.85 crore.

Overseas markets contributed another ₹451 crore gross, helping the film cement its position among the biggest global successes from India.

The domestic performance of Dhurandhar 2 was simply extraordinary. The film not only became the highest-grossing Bollywood film in India but also maintained strong collections deep into its theatrical run.

| Version | Collection |
| --- | --- |
| Hindi | ₹1110.12 crore |
| Tamil + Telugu + Kannada + Malayalam | ₹76.20 crore |
| Total India Net | ₹1186.32 crore |

The Hindi version alone contributed a gigantic ₹1110.12 crore net. The remaining ₹76.2 crore came from Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam versions.

This widespread acceptance across multiple languages helped the film achieve unprecedented milestones.

## Dhurandhar 2 Week-Wise Box Office Collection

| Week | India Net Collection |
| --- | --- |
| Week 1 (8 Days) | ₹690 crore |
| Week 2 | ₹271 crore |
| Week 3 | ₹120 crore |
| Week 4 | ₹58 crore |
| Week 5 | ₹20.63 crore |
| Week 6 | ₹12.50 crore |
| Week 7 | ₹5.54 crore |
| Week 8 | ₹3.89 crore |
| Week 9 | ₹2.19 crore |
| Week 10 | ₹1.45 crore |
| Week 11 | ₹0.82 crore |
| Week 12 | ₹0.15 crore |
| Total | ₹1186.32 crore |

One of the biggest reasons behind the film’s success was its consistency. While many films witness steep drops after the opening week, Dhurandhar 2 continued to generate impressive numbers week after week.

## Overseas Performance Was Equally Historic

The international run of Dhurandhar 2 deserves special mention. The film performed exceptionally well in North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, Germany, and several other territories.

By the end of its theatrical journey, the film had amassed ₹451 crore gross overseas, making it one of the most successful Bollywood films ever in international markets. The performance overseas continued the legacy of the first Dhurandhar, but on a much larger scale.

## Dhurandhar 2 Lifetime Records

The film’s final record list is enough to place it among the greatest theatrical successes in Indian cinema history.

- Highest-grossing film of Ranveer Singh
- Highest-grossing film of Aditya Dhar
- Highest-grossing Bollywood film of all time in India
- Highest-grossing film in Hindi cinema
- 2nd highest-grossing Bollywood film worldwide
- 2nd highest-grossing Indian film globally

These achievements highlight the scale of the phenomenon created by the film.

## Budget, Profit, And Verdict

| Parameter | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Budget | ₹225 crore |
| India Net | ₹1186.32 crore |
| Profit | ₹961.32 crore |
| ROI | 427% |
| Verdict | All Time Blockbuster |

Financially, Dhurandhar 2 delivered one of the biggest returns in Bollywood history. As of June 2026, it remains the most profitable Bollywood film of the year.

## Conclusion

The journey of Dhurandhar: The Revenge will be remembered for years. From record-breaking openings to an extraordinary 12-week theatrical run, the film delivered at every stage. It became the highest-grossing Bollywood film in India, emerged as the second biggest Bollywood film globally, and strengthened Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar’s position among the biggest names in Indian cinema.

While the theatrical run has finally concluded, the legacy of Dhurandhar 2 is only beginning. Its records, milestones, and box office achievements will continue to be discussed whenever conversations about Bollywood’s biggest blockbusters take place.
